New this week (Nov 9 to Nov 15, 2026): Wiz Khalifa "Cool", U2 "Carnaval de Luz", David Kushner "Devotion", Becky Hill "Rebecca", Mc Hariel "Aplauso Não Paga as Contas", Ashanti "The Rhythm & Soul of Christmas", SDM "IN INFINITUM", Royal Blood "Dead Company" and Niro "Mentalité".

Wiz Khalifa is the biggest name of the week with 46.0M Spotify monthly listeners. U2 lead the critics at 6.3 across 5 reviews. 152 albums came out this week in the playcount.fm catalog.
